message.transcript:
Assistant: Hello, this is the Example Supportive Housing Property incident reporter. Please tell me what is happening.
Tenant: My name is Maria. I am in unit 308. There is water leaking from the hallway ceiling near the third floor elevator.
Assistant: Is it happening right now, and does anyone appear injured or in danger?
Tenant: It is happening now. Nobody is injured, but the floor is getting slippery.
Assistant: Thank you. Your report will be reviewed by Example Supportive Housing Property management.
message.summary: Tenant reports an active water leak from the hallway ceiling near the third floor elevator. The floor is becoming slippery. No injuries reported.

structuredData.description: Active ceiling leak causing a slippery floor near the third floor elevator.

analysis.summary: Water leak hazard on third floor near elevator.
